description: Human-defined part of the strata: for each granularity stratum, the Biolink classes and mixins that anchor it, and the angle under which classes shared with other strata are read. Everything else (class membership, vertical is_a links, mixin groupings, predicate links between classes) is derived from biolink-model.yaml by scripts/build_biolink_strata.py.

biochemical.description: Molecular and cellular level: genes and gene products, small molecules and metabolites, molecular activities, pathways, cellular components, cellular phenotypes, and tissue specificity of molecular events.
anchor_mixins: chemical entity or gene or gene product

shared_angle.disease: causal genes, molecular mechanisms and molecular consequences of the disease
shared_angle.phenotypic feature: molecular and cellular phenotypes and readouts
shared_angle.anatomical entity: tissue and cell-type specificity of molecular events

clinical.description: Organism and patient level: diseases and phenotypes, clinical findings, treatments, trials and adverse effects, anatomy, physiology, behaviour, cohorts.
anchor_mixins: clinical trial and regulatory approval context mixin

shared_angle.gene: diagnostic markers, inherited causes and therapeutic targets
shared_angle.cell: histological and cellular features observed in patients
